business_summary: Shandong Sunway Chemical Group Co., Ltd. engages in engineering, chemical, and catalysts businesses in China. It offers engineering consultation, design, and procurement construction; and technical services. The company also produces and sells raw chemical materials, including propional, N-propanol, mixed butanol, crude octano, N-amylaldehyde, N-amyl alcohol, N-propyl acetate, and carbon 12; and sulfur - resistant transformation catalyst. In addition, it sells refined oil, plastics, sulfur, rubber, liquid chemicals, catalysts and other products. The company was formerly known as Shandong Sunway Petrochemical Engineering Co.,Ltd. The company was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Zibo, China.
